# Similarity network fusion

```{r eval = FALSE}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(scabcd)

# Import input variables
as_mtbi_loc <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/as_mtbi_loc.csv"))
as_mtbi_mechanism <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/as_mtbi_mechanism.csv"))
as_mtbi_mem_daze <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/as_mtbi_mem_daze.csv"))
d_income <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/d_income.csv"))
d_interview_age <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/d_interview_age.csv"))
d_mtbi_age <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/d_mtbi_age.csv"))
d_pubertal_status <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/d_pubertal_status.csv"))
d_race_cd <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/d_race_cd.csv"))
d_race_ed <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/d_race_ed.csv"))
d_sex <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/d_sex.csv"))
dm_wmndf <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/dm_wmndf.csv"))
mh_headaches <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/mh_headaches.csv"))
mh_mtbi_count <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/mh_mtbi_count.csv"))
rm_gord_cor <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/rm_gord_cor.csv"))
rm_gord_var <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/rm_gord_var.csv"))
rm_subc_cor <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/rm_subc_cor.csv"))
rm_subc_var <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/rm_subc_var.csv"))
sm_cort_sa <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/sm_cort_sa.csv"))
sm_cort_t <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/sm_cort_t.csv"))
sm_subc_v <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/sm_subc_v.csv"))


as_mtbi_loc <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/as_mtbi_loc.csv"))
as_mtbi_mem_daze <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/as_mtbi_mem_daze.csv"))
sm_subc_v <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/inputs/sm_subc_v.csv"))

# The essential data structure
data_list <- generate_data_list(mtbi_loc = as_mtbi_loc,
                                mtbi_mem_daze = as_mtbi_mem_daze,
                                subc_v = sm_subc_v)

# SNF
a <- snf_step(data_list, "individual")


set.seed(42)
design_matrix_base <- build_design_matrix_base_t()
design_matrix <- add_design_matrix_rows(design_matrix_base, 1)
design_matrix


execute_inclusion(data_list, design_matrix)

# Just iterate this through rows
# Dataframe just of the inclusion variables
inc_df <- design_matrix |>
    select(starts_with("inc"))

# The subset of columns that are in 'keep' (1) mode
keepcols <- colnames(inc_df)[inc_df[1, ] == 1]

# The list of data_list elements that are to be selected
in_keeps_list <- lapply(data_list,
    function(x) {
        paste0("inc_", x$"name") %in% keepcols
    })

# Converting to a logical type to do the selection
in_keeps_log <- c(unlist(in_keeps_list))

# The selection
selected_df <- data_list[in_keeps_log]
lapply(selected_df, function(x) x$"name")

```
